caption: The drawing features a single metal spur positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The spur has an arched, U-shaped body with two flat rectangular ends, each with a rectangular slot for attaching to a strap. The band of the spur is primarily a silvery metallic color with engraved scrollwork designs in light blue and gold tones, and it is accented by circular floral-like decorations in the middle. Extending from the end of the arch is a large, round rowel with multiple evenly spaced, pointed spokes, depicted in a dark metallic color. The neck of the spur curves outward and slightly downward to hold the rowel in place. Near the rowel, there is a small, rounded knob on the body of the spur. The drawing is labelled with the name "Harry Mann Waddell" in small, capitalized letters to the lower right of the object. There are no other objects or markings visible on the background.
title: Spur
